component.name: Maprisma Launcher
component.summary: Launch, group, install and remove your apps

description.p: All your apps in one window: type to filter, sort them into your own groups or by origin, see sizes, updates and what is running, and install or remove apps through the package managers you allow. An optional AI helper (Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity) suggests real packages for what you need; every install goes through a review that shows the exact command.
Runs on Omarchy, GNOME and COSMIC and follows the desktop's colours and language.
